patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout featuring an oversized brand name prominently positioned, contrasted with a product image.
Dramatic use of a very large, bold serif typeface for the hero brand name and key section titles, providing a strong visual anchor.
A restrained and sophisticated palette combining a light, warm neutral background with deep charcoal text and rich natural wood tones from product photography.
The oversized 'willett' brand name in the hero section dynamically scales down and repositions to become the compact logo in the sticky header as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections are presented with full-bleed, high-quality photography, often in grid or mosaic layouts, minimizing surrounding UI to emphasize the visuals.

technique_notes: A dynamic header system where a large, prominent brand name in the hero area transforms into a smaller, sticky logo within the navigation bar upon scroll, maintaining brand presence without consuming excessive space.

Content presentation relies heavily on full-bleed, high-resolution photography arranged in clean grids or staggered layouts, allowing the products and projects to speak for themselves with minimal textual overlay.
A modal overlay is used to capture user attention for newsletter sign-ups, appearing centrally over the page content, likely on page load or after a short delay.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very oversized, bold serif hero text (~6-8x body) with prominent but less exaggerated serif headings, complemented by clean, legible sans-serif body and navigation text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout all elements and imagery.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and open in the hero and between major content blocks, transitioning to a balanced density within product grids and text sections.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is the dramatic, oversized 'willett' brand name in the hero section that elegantly transforms and shrinks into a compact, sticky logo in the navigation bar upon scroll, creating a sophisticated and memorable brand introduction.
